name: Exterior Metal Primer
intent: Substrate-driven primer: DTM acrylic (ferrous), etch/bonding (non-ferrous). Method-gated: brush or spray.
doctrine: Metal primer. Product driven by substrate type: DTM acrylic/alkyd for carbon steel/wrought iron, etch primer for aluminum, bonding primer for galvanized. Galvanized + oil/alkyd = BLOCKED. Profile complexity modifier applies. Ornamental EA rate at 3/hr (~20 min/piece).
